original-whole.title: original 100%
original-whole.explanation: The original amount is the whole, represented by 100%. A changed amount can represent more or less than 100%.
original-whole.guidance: Identify which percentage the known amount represents.
examples: After a 20% reduction, the sale price represents 80% of the original price.

reverse-multiplier.title: multiplier
reverse-multiplier.explanation: A multiplier expresses the percentage as a decimal.
reverse-multiplier.guidance: Divide the known amount by the multiplier to undo the percentage calculation.

reverse-check.title: check
reverse-check.explanation: A check should rebuild the known amount from the original amount you found.
reverse-check.guidance: Apply the stated increase or decrease, and then any separate charge.
